blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Infant fingerprint recognition is hindered by a combination of physiological characteristics, such as small ridge width and spacing, and acquisition challenges that include involuntary motion, skin residue, and uneven fingertip pressure. These factors undermine fingerprint quality standards originally designed for adults, which assume feature distributions that do not hold for infants. To address this gap, this paper evaluates ten fingerprint quality assessment methods on a longitudinal dataset that spans six age groups from newborns to three months, alongside a parameter tuning routine that uncovers age-specific fingerprint characteristics to recalibrate methods with domain-dependent assumptions. Both default and tuned configurations are compared through recognition experiments assessing the effectiveness of quality-guided gallery selection. Template-fusion strategies and latent fingerprint recognition technologies are further examined to identify the best possible matching rates achievable by the top-performing method. Results show that tuned parameter sets outperform default configurations for the majority of methods and age groups, indicating that targeted recalibration of existing frameworks improves gallery utility and contributes to more reliable infant fingerprint recognition.
blocks.zh: 婴儿指纹的识别受到生理特征(如小脊宽度和间距)和获取挑战(包括非自愿运动、皮肤残留和指尖压力不均衡)的综合影响。 这些因素破坏了原先为成年人设计的指纹质量标准,后者假定特征分布对婴儿没有影响。 为了弥补这一差距,本文在从新生儿到三个月的6个年龄组的纵向数据集上评价了10个指纹质量评估方法,同时还评价了一个参数调整程序,该程序将不同年龄的指纹特征揭示出来,以重新校准方法,并采用依赖域的假设。 默认配置和调制配置均通过评估质量导轨选择的有效性的识别实验进行比较。 进一步审查模板集成战略和潜在指纹识别技术,以确定最佳匹配率,通过最佳方法实现。 结果显示,调制参数为大多数方法和年龄组规定了默认配置,表明有针对性地调整现有框架会改善画廊的效用,有助于更可靠的婴儿指纹识别。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Infant and adult fingerprints exhibit substantially different structural patterns. Infant ridges are markedly thinner and inter-ridge spacing may be up to four times smaller [ 1 , 2 ] , which directly motivates the use of high-resolution (1200-5000 PPI) scanners to preserve sufficient discriminative detail for recognition [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . In addition, infant fingers are softer and more elastic than those of adults, increasing susceptibility to deformation during image capture [ 3 ] . Figure 1 illustrates the acquisition process, alongside sample images that exhibit common capture degradations, including motion and residual contaminants such as lint and fiber residues.
blocks.zh: 婴儿和成年人的指纹显示出的结构模式大相径庭。 婴儿脊明显更薄,而脊间距可达4倍小[1,2],这直接促使人们使用高分辨率(1200-5000PPI)扫描仪来保存足够的歧视细节,以便识别[1,2,3,4,5]. 此外,与成年人相比,婴儿的手指更柔软更有弹性,在图像捕捉过程中更容易被变形. [3]. 图1说明了获取过程,以及显示常见捕捉降解的样本图像,包括运动和残留污染物,如林特和纤维残留等。

blocks.en: Solutions aiming to provide infants with reliable recognition systems must grapple with these physiological challenges; particular to this work is the problem of defining an acceptance criteria in structural conformity to quantify the quality of an infant fingerprint sample. In other words, the properties that constitute an acceptable sample for adult fingerprints may not hold for infants, and the structural bounds that define ridge and valley conformity must be reconsidered according to the subject’s age.
blocks.zh: 旨在向婴儿提供可靠识别系统的解决办法必须应对这些生理挑战;这项工作尤其需要确定结构一致性的接受标准,以量化婴儿指纹样本的质量。 换句话说,构成成人指纹可接受样本的特性对于婴儿可能不具有,界定山脊和谷地一致性的结构界限必须根据受试对象的年龄重新考虑。

blocks.en: Quality assessment plays a critical role within the biometric pipeline. By bridging the capture and processing stages, it influences the reliability of all subsequent operations. For adult biometrics, fingerprint quality assessment has been extensively investigated over the past decades, leading to the development of standardized methodologies such as ISO/IEC 29794-1 [ 7 ] and the widely adopted National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Fingerprint Image Quality 2 (NFIQ2) package [ 8 ] , which is integrated into modern comparators such as VeriFinger [ 9 ] . In contrast, quality assessment for infants is a relatively unexplored area, remaining largely restricted to the direct application of NFIQ (1 and/or 2) to infant fingerprint data [ 1 , 10 , 11 ] . Recent works on the topic of infant biometrics have focused on producing alternative high-resolution scanners [ 2 , 3 ] and the development of image enhancement techniques, including binarization [ 12 , 13 ] and super-resolution methods [ 4 , 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 质量评估在生物鉴别管道中发挥着关键作用。 通过连接捕获和处理阶段,它会影响所有后续操作的可靠性. 对于成人生物鉴别学,过去几十年中指纹质量评估被广泛调查,导致ISO/IEC 29794-1 [7]等标准化方法的制定,并被广泛采用的国家标准与技术研究所(NIST)指纹图像质量2 (NFIQ2)套件[8],被整合入维利芬格等现代参照物[9]. 与此相反,婴儿质量评估是一个相对未探索的领域,基本上仍限于直接将NFIQ(1和/或2)应用于婴儿指纹数据[1、10、11]。 最近关于婴儿生物鉴别学专题的著作侧重于生产替代高分辨率扫描仪[2,3],并开发图像增强技术,包括二进制[12,13]和超分辨率方法[4,14].

blocks.en: To address fingerprint quality assessment for infants, this study reviews established ISO/IEC 29794-1 [ 7 ] methods and more recent advancements [ 8 , 15 ] , selected according to their primary underlying features (e.g., ridge spacing, orientation), to determine whether existing solutions can reliably identify informative infant fingerprint samples, and explores age-sensitive parameter search to improve recognition rates. Both standard and tuned configurations are evaluated through a gallery selection problem: given a set of images from an identity, methods must rank samples according to their matching potential — a property commonly formalized in terms of utility for identification systems [ 16 ] . Experiments are repeated for six age-based subsets, spanning from newborns to three months of age, drawn from the UTFPR-IFD [ 5 ] longitudinal infant database.
blocks.zh: 为解决婴儿指纹质量评估问题,本研究审查了ISO/IEC 29794-1 [7] 方法以及最近的进步[8,15],根据它们的主要基本特征(如脊间距,取向)选择,以确定现有解决方案是否能够可靠地识别信息丰富的婴儿指纹样本,并探索对年龄敏感的参数搜索来提高识别率. 标准配置和调制配置都通过一个画廊选择问题来评价:如果从某种身份获得一组图像,方法必须根据其匹配潜力对样本进行排序——这种财产通常在识别系统的用途上正式确定[16]. 6个基于年龄的子集重复实验,从新生儿到3个月,取自UTFPR-IFD[5]纵向婴儿数据库.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this paper are as follows:
blocks.zh: 本文件的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en:
(i) We review and evaluate ten fingerprint quality assessment methods, encompassing classical signal-processing, structure-driven, and learning-based approaches, that capture complementary fingerprint properties through both local and global image features. (ii) A systematic parameter search routine is introduced to identify optimal infant ridge and valley property (width, distance, etc) ranges. This process is performed independently for each parameter-dependent method and age group, aiming to maximize the biometric utility of galleries selected through quality ranking. (iii) To assess the effectiveness of quality-driven fingerprint selection across age groups, identity galleries are composed using the top-ranked samples selected by each quality assessment method, separately. Using VeriFinger 2025.2 [ 9 ] , quantitative and qualitative analyses
compare standard and optimized parameter configurations for infant fingerprints. (iv) A complementary analysis examines a practical deployment scenario, combining a template-fusion strategy with a state-of-the-art latent comparator (MegaMatcher 2025.2 [ 9 ] ) to investigate the best possible matching rates achieved by a top-performing quality method identified in this study.

(一) 我们审查和评价10个指纹质量评估方法,包括传统的信号处理、结构驱动和以学习为基础的方法,这些方法通过当地和全球图像特征收集补充指纹特性。 (二)引入系统参数搜索常规,以识别最佳婴儿脊和山谷属性(宽度,距离等)范围. 这一过程是针对每个参数依赖的方法和年龄组独立进行的,目的是尽量扩大通过质量排名选定的画廊的生物鉴别功能。 (三)为了评估各年龄组质量驱动的指纹选择的有效性,使用每种质量评估方法选择的排名最高的样本组成身份画廊。 使用VeriFinger 2025.2[9],定量和定性分析

blocks.en: This paper is structured as follows: Section II reviews related work, including quality assessment methods evaluated for parameter optimization in infant fingerprint recognition, as described in Section III . Section IV evaluates the impact of these methods on recognition performance, with and without tuned parameters; finally, Section V discusses the implications of these findings, and Section VI summarizes the contributions and outlines future research directions.

blocks.en: II Fingerprint quality estimation methods
blocks.zh: 二. 指纹质量估计方法

blocks.en: Fingerprint quality estimation has been addressed through a broad range of methodologies that differ both in features used to characterize ridge patterns (orientation, width, frequency, pores, minutiae) and in how such features are extracted, from handcrafted descriptors to deep learning representations. Existing surveys [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] focus on adult fingerprints, leaving infant fingerprint quality assessment largely unexplored.

blocks.en: Methods subjected to parameter optimization are grouped into two categories: • Strong domain assumptions : methods whose parameters are directly associated to fingerprint morphology, including ridge frequency, ridge width, and orientation consistency. Representative examples include Gabor-based methods [ 20 ] , gray-level analysis for Local Clarity Score (LCS [ 21 ] ), and Radial Power Analysis (RPS [ 22 ] ). Their dependence on expected ridge-valley patterns makes them particularly relevant for domain-specific optimization in infant fingerprints. • Weak domain assumptions : comprises methods — Orientation Certanty Level (OCL [ 23 ] ), Ridge-Valley Uniformity (RVU [ 23 ] ) and Directional Filter Bands (DFB [ 15 ] ) — whose parameters are exclusively related to the size of a local analysis region. Although these methods rely less on explicit assumptions about ridge morphology, their performance may still depend on the appropriate spatial scale for the finer ridge patterns found in infant fingerprints.

blocks.en: Methods with minimal or implicit parameterization form the remaining group: (i) purely statistical approaches, mean gray-level intensity (MU [ 7 ] ) and the standard deviation of gray-level intensities (SIG [ 7 ] ), that need no explicit parameters; and (ii) data-driven COTS solutions (MQCDA [ 6 ] model, NFIQ2 [ 8 ] ) trained on fixed configurations. The simpler statistical methods, which assess quality from global grey-level intensity, are more readily applicable to infants, but are correspondingly less sensitive to fine structural detail. The current obstacle is thus to determine the expected ranges for ridge and valley thickness or dominant frequency that best suit infant fingerprints.
blocks.zh: 最小参数化或隐含参数化的方法构成剩余组别:(一)纯统计方法,指灰色水平强度(MU [7])和灰色水平强度的标准偏差(SIG [7]),不需要明确的参数;和(二)由数据驱动的COTS解决方案(MQCDA [6]模型,NFIQ2 [8]),接受固定配置培训. 比较简单的统计方法从全球灰度强度来评估质量,比较容易适用于婴儿,但相应的对细微的结构细节不太敏感. 因此,目前的障碍是确定最适合婴儿指纹的山脊和山谷厚度或主要频率的预期范围。

blocks.en: Sampling rate intensifies this barrier: most solutions assume a sampling rate near 500 PPI, while infant fingerprints require higher rates to resolve sufficient detail. One exception is [ 24 ] , which uses pores as quality indicators for high-resolution images; however, infant pores are rarely visible, particularly in the first months of life. As later detailed in Section III-A , this study is limited to analyses of 5000 PPI images downsampled to 500 PPI to maintain compatibility with COTS comparators and spatial correspondence with adult fingerprints.
blocks.zh: 采样率强化了这一屏障:大多数解决方案假设采样率接近500PPI,而婴儿指纹则需要更高的率来解决足够的细节. 其中一个例外是[24],它使用孔孔作为高分辨率图像的质量指标;然而,婴儿孔孔孔很少可见,特别是在生命的头几个月. 如第三-A节所详述,本研究仅限于分析5000个PPI图像被取样到500个PPI,以保持与COTS比较器的相容性并保持与成人指纹的空间对应.

blocks.en: Lastly, all methods are further categorized as either global, assigning a single score to the entire image, or local, scoring regions separately. Though localized representations are generally preferred [ 19 ] , global approaches remain widely adopted largely due to NFIQ2. Local scoring is, however, useful for applications such as image enhancement [ 25 , 26 ] and composition [ 27 ] , potentially benefiting the broader infant fingerprint recognition pipeline.
blocks.zh: 最后,所有方法被进一步归类为全球方法,给整个图像分配一个分数,或者将地方、分数区域分开。 虽然地方性表述一般是首选[19],但主要由于国家森林信息调查表2,全球做法仍然得到广泛采用。 然而,当地评分对图像增强[25、26]和组成[27]等应用很有用,有可能有利于更广泛的婴儿指纹识别管道。

blocks.en: To the best of the authors’ knowledge, no existing study targets infant fingerprint quality specifically. This gap is reasonably explained by the scarcity of infant fingerprint datasets [ 28 ] and by the lack of robust synthetic fingerprint generation even for adults [ 29 ] . Consequently, how well current quality assessment methods transfer to infants depends heavily on their underlying assumptions and adaptability to age-related biometric differences.
blocks.zh: 据提交人所知,现有研究没有专门针对婴儿指纹的质量。 造成这一差距的原因有:婴儿指纹数据集的稀缺性[28],甚至成年人也无法生成强力合成指纹[29]。 因此,目前向婴儿转移的质量评估方法如何充分取决于其基本假设和适应与年龄有关的生物鉴别差异。

blocks.en: The following section proposes a parameter search for reviewed methods, using a longitudinal database [ 5 ] to capture the patterns of different infant age groups.
blocks.zh: 下一节建议对被审查的方法进行参数搜索,使用纵向数据库[5]来捕捉不同婴幼儿年龄组的模式.

blocks.en: III Parameter search for infants
blocks.zh: 页:1 婴儿参数搜索

blocks.en: Given that several quality assessment methods rely on intrinsic fingerprint features such as ridge width and spacing, a natural question arises as to whether, and to what extent, parameters originally derived from adult distributions appropriately capture infant features. To investigate this scenario, a parameter search is performed over infant subjects from hours after birth to 3 months of age.
blocks.zh: 鉴于几种质量评估方法依赖诸如山脊宽度和间距等内在指纹特征,自然会产生一个问题,即最初从成人分布中得出的参数是否以及在多大程度上适当地捕捉出婴儿特征。 为了调查这一情形,从出生后数小时到3个月,对婴儿对象进行了参数搜索。

blocks.en: III-A Infant Dataset and Experimental Protocol
blocks.zh: III-A 婴儿数据集和实验议定书

blocks.en: The UTFPR infant fingerprint dataset (UTFPR-IFD) [ 5 ] spans longitudinal video acquisitions captured using the high-resolution ( ∼ \sim 5000 PPI) InfantID optical fingerprint scanner. The dataset includes recordings from infants at multiple age milestones, beginning with an initial acquisition in the São Lucas hospital (city of Pato Branco, Paraná state, Brazil), within 3–24 hours after birth, followed by scheduled follow-up in-house visitations (see Figure 3 ). The data collection protocol was approved by the Brazilian research ethics committee under Certificate of Ethical Appreciation Presentation (CAAE) 73791023.7.0000.0177 via Plataforma Brasil . This dataset is not currently available to the general public due to ethical restrictions related to the age of the subjects. Consent for collection was provided by their legal guardians.
blocks.zh: UTFPR婴儿指纹数据集(UTFPR-IFD)[5]跨出使用高分辨(QQ\sim 5000 PPI) InfantID光学指纹扫描仪捕获的纵向视频获取. 数据集包括婴儿在多岁阶段的录音,首先是在出生后3至24小时内在圣卢卡斯医院(巴西巴拉那州帕托布兰科市)进行初步采购,然后安排内部后续访问(见图3)。 巴西研究伦理委员会根据道德鉴赏证书(CAAE)第73791023.7.0000.0177号法律批准了数据收集规程。 平方阵a 巴西语. 由于与主体年龄有关的道德限制,该数据集目前不向公众开放. 其法定监护人同意收集。

blocks.en: This study considers a curated subset of the UTFPR-IFD, which was selected according to two inclusion criteria: (i) subjects must have complete longitudinal coverage across all acquisition milestones up to three months of age; and (ii) each session must contain the full set of 14 expected video samples, as acquisition artifacts may occasionally lead to missing data. Based on the longest currently available observation window (March 2024 to September 2025), a total of 45 infants met these criteria. In total, this subset comprises 3,780 high-resolution video sequences ( 45 × 14 × 6 45\times 14\times 6 ) acquired from 450 distinct digits across 6 sessions over time, and containing 135,382 video frames in total.
blocks.zh: 本研究考虑了UTFPR-IFD的一个被整理的子集,该子集是根据两个包含标准来选择的:(一) 主体必须拥有全部纵向覆盖,覆盖所有到三个月年龄的购置里程碑;和(二) 每一会必须包含完整的14个预期视频样本,因为购置文物有时可能导致数据缺失. 根据目前最长的观测窗口(2024年3月至2025年9月),共有45名婴儿达到这些标准。 这个子集共由3,780个高分辨率视频序列(45 × 14 × 6 45\times 14\times 6 )组成,这些视频序列是随时间推移从6个会话的450个不同数字获得的,总共包含135,382个视频帧.

blocks.en: Fig. 3 : Overview of the UTFPR-IFD dataset [ 5 ] . A total of 14 fingerprint videos are acquired per session from both hands, with thumbs and index fingers captured twice due to their higher recognition utility. Stacked images represent the video-based frames collected at each stage of life

blocks.en: A 5-fold cross-validation is applied to the selected subjects, partitioning five different subsets for each age group that contains 36 subjects for training and 9 for testing. The same subject partition is applied to all six age groups to prevent identity leakage. Training data is further subsampled using a minimum inter-frame distance of three frames to reduce the temporal redundancy inherent to video-based acquisitions. This limits correlation and computational overhead while preserving sufficient variability for parameter search.
blocks.zh: 对所选科目实行5倍交叉校验,对每个年龄段划分出5个不同的子集,包含36个培训科目和9个测试科目. 同样的主体划分适用于所有6个年龄组,以防止身份泄露。 培训数据还采用三帧最小帧相距进行进一步取样,以减少基于视频的购置所固有的时间冗余。 这限制了相关性和计算间接费用,同时为参数搜索保留了足够的可变性.

blocks.en: Neurotechnology’s VeriFinger 2025.2 and MegaMatcher SDK 2025.2 [ 9 ] are employed to evaluate frame selection performance. Because these technologies are designed to operate on 500 PPI images, which remains the de facto standard for most operational systems, prior to template extraction all video frames were downsampled from 5000 to 500 PPI using bilinear interpolation with pixel area relation, while preserving the original aspect ratio. This preprocessing step reflects a practical limitation of computation and current fingerprint matching technology, as support for high-resolution ( > > 500 PPI) fingerprint matching remains limited in commercial-grade SDKs. Similar protocols have been adopted in previous studies on infant fingerprints, where high-resolution acquisitions were resampled to standard resolutions to ensure compatibility with existing matchers [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 利用了神经技术的VeriFinger 2025.2和MegaMatcher SDK 2025.2[9]来评价帧选择性能. 因为这些技术被设计为在500个PPI图像上运行,这仍然是大多数操作系统的实际标准,所以在模板提取之前,所有视频帧都通过有像素区域关系的双线插值来从5000到500个PPI进行下取样,同时保留了原来的相距比. 这个预处理步骤反映了对计算和当前指纹匹配技术的实际限制,因为支持高分辨率( > > > 500个PPI)指纹匹配在商业级SDK仍然有限. 在以往关于婴儿指纹的研究中也采用了类似的规程,其中高分辨率的获取被重印到标准分辨率上,以确保与现有的匹配者相容 [2].

blocks.zh: 三-B 参数搜索空间

blocks.en: IV Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 四. 实验结果

blocks.en: This section presents the parameter tuning results and extends the fingerprint comparison analysis to True and False Matching Rates (TMR@FMR), encompassing all methods across the observed age groups. A complementary analysis examines template fusion with a latent comparator to improve matching rates.

blocks.en: IV-A Parameter Tuning
blocks.zh: 参数Tuning

blocks.en: Table II summarizes the final parameter intervals for relevant fingerprint characteristics, namely the dominant ridge frequency (RPS) and the ridge/valley width parameters used by LCS. The reported intervals were obtained over in a separate execution that used the full 450 digits dataset to obtain a representative characterization of the entire available cohort. Although these quantities are used as algorithmic parameters in fingerprint enhancement and quality assessment, they are closely related to underlying ridge-valley features and therefore provide insights into the image properties that mostly influence matching performance across different ages.
blocks.zh: 表二汇总了相关指纹特征的最终参数间隔,即主脊频率(RPS)和LCS使用的脊/Valley宽度参数. 报告的间隔是在一次单独的处决中取得的,该处决使用了完整的450位数数据集,以获得整个现有组群的代表性特征。 尽管这些量被作为指纹增强和质量评估的算法参数,但它们与基础的山脊-Valley特征密切相关,因此提供了对图像属性的洞察力,这些特性主要影响不同年代的匹配性能.

blocks.en: TABLE II : Tuned RPS and LCS parameter intervals for each age group (in pixels). Adult reference ranges reported in [ 7 ] are included for comparison.
blocks.zh: 表二:每个年龄组(以像素为单位)的调用RPS和LCS参数间隔。 列入[7]所报成人参考范围以供比较。

blocks.en: The dominant ridge frequency is algorithmically found to be consistently higher for infants. It is also shown to increase with age over the observed period, which can be attributed to improvements in ridge–valley delineation as illustrated in Figure 3 : poorly defined valleys in younger subjects artificially widen ridges, reducing the measured frequency.
blocks.zh: 从算法上看,主要山脊频率对婴儿来说一直较高。 也显示,在观测期间,其年龄随着年龄的增长而增加,这可归因于从图3可以看出的山脊-谷地划界的改善:较年轻的地道中定义不清的地道人为地拓宽了山脊,减少了所测量的频率。

blocks.en: However, progression is not strictly harmonious across all methods. At 15 days, dominant frequency estimates already align with those of older age groups, while at 1 month the lower ridge-width bound decreases. Similar fluctuations across early infant age groups have been reported in prior work [ 10 , 11 ] . Furthermore, the ridge-to-valley width ratios inferred for newborns are consistent with [ 2 ] , where ridges were approximately four times larger than valleys, and the valley-width intervals for the 1 to 3 month groups align with the averages reported by [ 10 , 11 ] , noting that direct numerical correspondence is not expected as the present framework operates on integer-valued pixel intervals.
blocks.zh: 然而,进展并非在所有方法之间严格协调。 在15天内,主要频率估计数已经与老年群体相同,而下行山脊-宽度约束线在1个月内下降。 据报道,在以前的工作[10、11]中,幼儿年龄组也出现类似的波动。 此外,为新生儿推断的山脊至谷地宽度比与[2]一致,因为山脊比谷地大约4倍,而1至3个月组的河谷-谷地相距与[10,11]报告的平均值一致,指出由于本框架按整数等象素相距运行,预计不会出现直接数值对应。

blocks.en: The resulting effect of parameter tuning in the cross-validation experiment is an accelerated decay of FNMR for the tuned (opt.) configurations compared to the default (def.) values. Figure 4 presents the FNMR obtained on the held-out subjects of each cross-validation fold, using parameters optimized exclusively on the corresponding training folds. The results show that tuned configurations consistently reduce FNMR relative to the default settings, although the magnitude of the improvement varies across methods. In particular, LCS is more responsive to parameter tuning, whereas Gabor and OCL achieve only minor performance gains.
blocks.zh: 参数调试在交叉验证实验中产生的效应是,与默认值(def.)相比,调制(opt.)配置的FNMR加速衰变. 图4列出每个交叉验证折叠物的搁置主体获得的FNMR,完全使用在相应训练折叠上优化的参数. 结果显示,与默认设置相比,调制配置持续减少FNMR,尽管改进程度因方法而异. 特别是,LCS更能响应参数调谐,而Gabor和OCL只实现微小的性能收益.

blocks.en: Fig. 4 : FNMR plots for default (def.) and tuned (opt.) parameters for all methods (one per panel), accumulated across all six age groups and all 30 folds. Lower values indicate better performance.
blocks.zh: 图4:用于默认的FNMR地块(def.)并调制(opt.)所有方法的参数(每面板一个),在所有6个年龄组和所有30个折叠中累积. 数值较低表明业绩较好。

blocks.en: Figure 5 illustrates how the different default (def.) and tuned (opt.) scores behave over videos using LCS and a newborn thumb captured hours after birth. Tuned LCS assigns its highest score to a more informative frame, whereas the default configuration selects a blurred mid-movement frame. The key difference in gallery selection is that tuning produces more discriminative quality scores because the parameter bounds are adapted to the feature distribution of newborn fingerprints, thereby enabling more effective filtering.
blocks.zh: 图5说明了不同默认值(def.)和调取(opt.)的分数如何在使用LCS的视频和出生后数小时捕获的新生儿拇指上表现. Turned LCS将其最高分分配到一个更丰富的框架,而默认配置则选择一个模糊的中位移动框架. 画廊选取的关键区别在于:调取因参数界限被调整为新生儿指纹的特征分布而产生出更具有歧视性的质量分数,从而能够更有效地过滤.

blocks.en: Fig. 5 : LCS scoring of a newborn thumb (test only subset). The fingerprint core region is showcased for the best frames selected by the default and tuned configurations.
blocks.zh: 图5:新生儿拇指的LCS分数(只测试子集). 指纹核心区域被显示为默认和调制配置所选择的最佳框架.

blocks.en: IV-B Recognition Results
blocks.zh: IV-B 确认结果

blocks.en: To evaluate the performance of the quality assessment methods across age group subsets, each method independently constructs a 5-frame gallery for every digit, selecting frames according to its own quality score ranking while enforcing a minimum inter-frame distance of three frames, as described in Section III-A . Similar to the FVC protocol [ 32 ] , each identity then contributes a single sample (highest average genuine comparison score) to compose the gallery of impostors, which is fixed per age group and invariant across methods to ensure that differences in performance reflect only the genuine gallery composition. This is made possible because genuine comparisons are restricted to frames within the same video. Accordingly, each frame is subject to 4 genuine and 89 impostor comparisons, totaling 1,800 genuine and 40,050 impostor pairs per method/age group and fold. NFIQ2 is used as the reference baseline, being the most consolidated adult quality method; the default configurations of the remaining methods provide a second baseline.
blocks.zh: 为了评价各年龄组子集的质量评估方法的性能,如第三节A所描述的,每种方法独立地为每位数字构建了5个框架的画廊,根据自己的质量分数排名选择了框架,同时执行三个框架的最低跨框架距离。 与FVC协议相类似[32],每个身份再贡献出一个单一的样本(最高平均真实比较分数)来构成冒牌货的画廊,画廊按年龄组固定并不同方法不相上下,以确保性能的差异只反映真正的画廊组成. 之所以能够做到这一点,是因为真正的比较仅限于同一视频内的帧。 因此,每个框架要进行4个真假和89个假假的比较,每个方法/年龄组和折叠共1 800个真假和40 050个假假假对。 NFIQ2作为参考基准,是最综合的成人质量方法;其余方法的默认配置提供了第二个基准.

blocks.en: Table III presents VeriFinger 2025.2 TMR@FMR=0.1% and 1.0% results for each quality estimation method across all age groups in our test subset of UTFPR-IFD. An accept is defined as the successful matching of individual frames to enable a detailed evaluation of gallery utility, though higher rates can be achieved with stricter protocols as Section IV-C later explores.
blocks.zh: 表三列示了VeriFinger 2025.2 TMR@FMR=0.1%和1.0%的测试子集UTFPR-IFD中各年龄组质量估计方法的结果。 接受的定义是,成功匹配单个帧,以便能够详细评价画廊的效用,尽管随着第四节-C部分的后期探索,更严格的协议可以实现更高的速率.

blocks.en: TABLE III : Mean matching performance (TMR@FMR=0.1% and 1.0 % 1.0\% ) by age and method (90 digits per fold, 5 folds) with standard deviation. Bold values indicate best results per method, underlined values indicate best results for each age.
blocks.zh: 表三:平均匹配性能(TMR@FMR=0.1%和1.0-%),按年龄和方法(每折90位数,5个折)划分,标准偏差. 粗体值表示每种方法的最佳结果,下划线值表示每一年龄的最佳结果。

blocks.en: A complementary Friedman analysis, followed by the post-hoc Nemenyi test [ 33 ] , was conducted to compare the quality assessment methods across age groups and folds ( 6 6 age groups × \times 5 5 folds = 30 =30 blocks). Table IV reports the mean ranks at FMR=1.0%, adopted as the reference operating point because single-frame comparisons are inherently more error-prone than the decisions of biometric systems, which can aggregate several fingers. Two methods are considered significantly different only if their mean ranks differ by more than the critical difference ( CD = 4.2 \mathrm{CD}=4.2 , α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 ).
blocks.zh: 进行了补充性弗里德曼分析,并随后进行了后Hoc Nemenyi测试[33],以比较各年龄组和折叠的质量评估方法(6个6个年龄组×\times 5个5个折叠=30个个区块)。 表四报告的平均排名为FMR=1.0%,作为参考操作点,因为单帧比较在本质上比生物鉴别系统的决定更容易出错,生物鉴别系统可以将几个指头组合在一起。 两种方法只有在其平均等级差异大于临界差别时才被认为有显著不同(CD = 4.2\mathrm{CD}= 4.2, α = 0.05\alpha=0.05)。

blocks.en: TABLE IV : Friedman-Nemenyi ranking analysis of quality methods (lower rank = better performance) at FMR=1.0%.
blocks.zh: 表四:Friedman-Nemenyi按FMR=1.0%对质量方法的排名分析(下级=较好的性能).

blocks.en: Tuned configurations obtained higher mean TMR than their defaults in every method-age combination (36/36), at FMR=1.0%, and in 32 of 36 at FMR=0.1% (Table III ). The exceptions at 0.1% were Gabor (three age groups), and LCS (1-month). Out of all the evaluated methods, tuned RPS obtained the lowest mean rank ( 2.8 2.8 ), although it was not significantly different from the other top-five methods of Table IV . It obtained the highest mean TMR for the 2- and 3-month groups at both FMRs, and for the 15-day group at FMR=0.1%, but was less competitive for newborns ( 47.5 % 47.5\% vs. 53.6 % 53.6\% for LCS at FMR=1.0%). Tuning contributed to this outcome: tuned RPS ranks 5.0 5.0 units better than its default configuration at FMR=1.0%, exceeding the CD, and its TMR gains at FMR=0.1% range from 0.7 0.7 to 6.9 6.9 points (tuned vs. default).
blocks.zh: 在每种方法年龄组合(36/36)、FMR=1.0%和FMR=0.1%的36个中,有32个得到的平均德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国(见表三)。 Gabor(三个年龄组)和LCS(1个月)例外,为0.1%。 在所有评估方法中,调制的RPS获得了最低的中位数(2.8 2.8),尽管它与表四其他前五名方法没有显著区别。 它在两个半年期和半年期中获得了最高的平均德涅斯特河沿岸死亡率,在15天期中为0.1%;但在新生儿中,其竞争力较低(在半年期和半年期中为47.5%;在半年期中为53.6%;在半年期中为1.0%)。 Tuning促成了这一结果:调制的RPS在FMR=1.0%的默认配置上排名优于它的5.0 5.0个单位,超过CD,其FMR=0.1%的德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国增益从0.7分到6.9分到6.9分(调制与默认).

blocks.en: Tuned LCS also improved significantly over its default configuration, with a mean-rank difference of Δ = 5.6 \Delta=5.6 , above the CD. This is consistent with expectations regarding LCS’s dependence on ridge and valley width ranges, which differ between infants and the adult standard and vary with age. In Table III , tuned LCS obtained the highest mean TMR at FMR=1.0% for infants aged 15 days or younger, although its margins over the next best method ( 2.4 2.4 , 0.7 0.7 and 0.7 0.7 points for newborn, 7-day and 15-day) are within the fold standard deviation. At FMR=0.1%, its gains over the default configuration reached 7.8 7.8 points (15-day), with the 1-month group as the only exception ( − 0.7 -0.7 ). It also obtained the third lowest mean rank at FMR=1.0% ( 4.4 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: Tuned LCS也比其默认配置有显著改善,中分差为:QQ= 5.6\Delta= 5.6,高于CD. 这与LCS对山脊和河谷宽度的依赖程度的预期是一致的,因为山脊和河谷宽度因婴儿和成人标准不同而不同,年龄也不同。 在表三中,根据15天或更小的婴儿的FMR=1.0%计算,LCS得到的最高平均德涅斯特河沿岸死亡率,尽管其在下一个最佳方法中的差值(新生儿2.4 2.4分、0.7分和0.7分、7天和15天)在折叠标准差之内。 在FMR=0.1%时,其在默认配置上的得分达到7.8分(15天),1个月组是唯一的例外(−0.7-0.7). 它还在FMR=1.0%(4.4 4.4)上获得了第三位最低中位数。

blocks.en: Gabor tuning, however, presented mixed results. It did not obtain the highest mean TMR in any age group of Table III , and tuning did not consistently improve on the default setting at FMR=0.1%: the default configuration achieved higher mean TMR for the 7-day, 1-month and 3-month groups, with differences of at most 0.9 0.9 point. At FMR=1.0%, tuned Gabor obtained higher mean TMR in all six age groups (by 0.3 0.3 to 3.3 3.3 points). This was sufficient to place it among the top five methods at FMR=1.0% in Table IV , however the mean rank difference of Δ = 2.3 \Delta=2.3 remained below the CD.
blocks.zh: 然而,加博尔调试的结果好坏参半。 它没有获得表三任何年龄组中最高平均德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国的数值,而且调整在FMR=0.1%的默认设置上没有取得一致的改善:7天、1个月和3个月组的默认配置实现了较高的平均德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国,差异为0.9分。 在FMR=1.0%时,调制Gabor在所有6个年龄组获得较高的平均德涅斯特河沿岸死亡率(0.3至3.33.3分)。 这足以将它列入表四中FMR=1.0%的五大方法中,但平均排名相差2.3\Delta=2.3仍然低于裁谈会。

blocks.en: MQCDA and SIG, which underwent no optimization, complete the top five rank of Table IV . MQCDA is a commercial deep-learning model whose architecture and training data are not publicly documented, and it is the only method evaluated that specifically targets children, which may explain its competitive performance across age groups. At FMR=0.1%, it obtained the highest mean TMR for newborns ( 35.0 % 35.0\% ) and 1-month infants ( 80.5 % 80.5\% ), with margins of 0.5 0.5 and 0.4 0.4 points over the next best method. SIG, the standard deviation of pixel gray-level intensities, is independent of age and resolution and makes no assumptions about fingerprint-specific traits, making it a plausible alternative for datasets with variable characteristics such as evolving infant fingerprints. It obtained the highest mean TMR for the 7-day group at FMR=0.1% ( 59.1 % 59.1\% , 1.5 1.5 points over MQCDA).
blocks.zh: MQCDA和SIG没有经过优化,它们完成了表四的前五名。 MQCDA是一种商业的深入学习模式,其架构和培训数据没有公开记录,它是唯一被评价的专门针对儿童的方法,这可以解释其跨年龄组的竞争表现。 在FMR=0.1%时,它获得了新生儿(35.0% 35.0%)和1个月婴儿(80.5% 80.5%)的最高平均德涅斯特河沿岸死亡率,比下一个最佳方法差0.5分和0.4分。 SIG,像素灰相位强度的标准偏差,与年龄和分辨率无关,没有关于指纹特异性的假设,使得它成为具有诸如演化出婴儿指纹等可变特征的数据集的可行替代品. 它以FMR=0.1%(59.1%为59.1%,比MQCDA高1.5分)获得7天组的平均德涅斯特河沿岸死亡率最高。

blocks.en: Within the top five methods, no pair differs significantly at FMR=1.0% (Table IV ), as the largest rank gap ( 2.1 2.1 ) is below the CD ( 4.2 4.2 ). The remaining methods produced mixed results.
blocks.zh: 在前五种方法中,在FMR=1.0%(表四)时,无一对差别很大,因为最大的排名差距(2.1 2.1)低于CD(4.2 4.2)。 其余方法的结果好坏参半。

blocks.en: Tuned DFB performed significantly better than its default setting ( Δ = 5.3 \Delta=5.3 ), obtaining higher mean TMR than its default in all six age groups at FMR=0.1%, and ranked above NFIQ2 ( 6.8 6.8 vs. 8.3 8.3 ), although not significantly. Considering its performance against standard methods, it may represent a strong filter-based alternative to more traditional quality measures. Block-size tuning of OCL and RVU also improved their results, but not sufficiently to improve rankings above the NFIQ2 baseline. For RVU the rank gain was significant ( Δ = 5.2 \Delta=5.2 ), which translated to TMR gains ranging from 2.7 2.7 to 11.4 11.4 points at both FMR thresholds. For OCL results were modest, with gains to TMR means capped at 2.1 2.1 points and a mean rank difference of 1.5 1.5 , below the CD.
blocks.zh: Tuned DFB的性能明显好于其默认设置(QQ = 5.3\Delta= 5.3),以FMR=0.1%的成绩获得高于所有6个年龄段的默认的德涅斯特河沿岸死亡率,排名高于NFIQ2(6.8 6.8 vs 8.3 8.3),虽然并不显著. 考虑到它相对于标准方法的性能,它可能是较传统的质量衡量标准的一种强有力的基于过滤的替代办法。 OCL和RVU的区块尺寸调整也改善了它们的成果,但不足以改善高于NFIQ2基线的排名. 对于RVU来说,军衔增益是巨大的( = 5.2\Delta= 5.2),这相当于在FMR两个阈值中得分从2.7分到11.4分不等。 就OCL而言,结果不大,对德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国的收益是上限为2.1 2.1分,平均分差为1.5 1.5分,低于CD。

blocks.en: Lastly, NFIQ2 ranked above its constituent features with the notable exception of SIG and tuned LCS. This difference was significant for MU, and default OCL and RVU (rank gaps of 4.7 4.7 , 4.9 4.9 and 7.2 7.2 , respectively). However, incorporating tuned versions of these features into an infant focused index could still improve its performance on infant fingerprints. In particularly LCS, which obtained higher mean TMR than NFIQ2 in all six age groups at FMR=1.0% (five of six at FMR=0.1%), although its rank gap to NFIQ2 at Δ = 3.9 \Delta=3.9 was slightly below the CD. In addition to current NFIQ2 features, overall recognition results suggest that a composite quality measure designed specifically for children might benefit from combining additional methods such as RPS and Gabor.
blocks.zh: 最后,NFIQ2的排名高于其组成特征,显著的例外是SIG和调制LCS. 这一差异对MU、默认OCL和RVU来说是显著的(分别为4.7 4.7、4.9 4.9和7.2 7.2)。 然而,将这些特征的调制版本纳入婴儿重点指数,仍能提高婴儿指纹的性能。 特别是LCS,在所有6个年龄组中,其平均得分高于NFIQ2,FMR=1.0%(FMR=0.1%为6分中的5分),尽管其与NFIQ2的排名差距为Q=3.9\Delta=3.9,略低于CD。 除了目前的NFIQ2特征外,总体确认结果表明,结合诸如RPS和Gabor等额外方法,可有利于专门为儿童设计的综合质量衡量标准。

blocks.en: Figure 6 further illustrates the recognition results with the Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) curves for the best-performing methods at FMR=1.0% (Table III ), selected separately for each age group. Two key observations follow: (i) newborn and 7-day samples exhibit considerably lower recognition rates than the older age groups, even at the relatively lenient FMR=10% operating point; and (ii) after 15 days, performance differences become comparatively small, with fluctuations causing the 3-month group to exhibit slightly lower rates despite being comprised of the oldest samples.
blocks.zh: 图6进一步说明了以FMR=1.0%(表三)作为最佳方法的接收器操作特征曲线(ROC)的识别结果,该曲线为每个年龄组分别选定。 下面是两项关键观察:(一) 新生儿和7天样本的识别率比老年组要低得多,即使在相对宽松的FMR=10%的操作点也是如此;(二) 15天后,性能差异相对小,波动导致3个月组的识别率略低,尽管是最古老样本。

blocks.en: Fig. 6 : TMR@FMR curves by age group. Each curve corresponds to the top-performing quality assessment method at FMR=1.0% for its respective age group.
blocks.zh: 图6:TMR@FMR曲线按年龄组划分. 每道曲线对应于各年龄组最高性能质量评估方法(FMR=1.0%)。

blocks.en: IV-C Improvements to Matching Rates
blocks.zh: 提高匹配率

blocks.en: In order to improve TMR values, the top-ranked quality methods of Table III are combined with a simple frame-fusion strategy. Under this strategy, an “accept” requires the probe frame to match at least two frames of the same digits gallery. As such, a genuine probe is compared with the other four frames of its own gallery (all others besides itself), whereas an impostor probe frame is compared with all five gallery frames. This process is less strict than a fusion between two or more digits because it limits combinations to images of the same finger, rather than fingers of the same person.
blocks.zh: 为了提高德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国的数值,表三中排名最高的质量方法与简单的帧融合策略相结合. 根据这一战略,“接受”要求探测相框至少匹配同位数相框的两个相框。 因此,真实的探测器被比作自己画廊的其他四个相框(除了自身之外,其他所有相框),而假相的探测器相框被比作所有五个相框. 这个过程比两个或两个以上位数之间的聚变不太严格,因为它将组合限制在同指的相片上,而不是同一人的相指上.

blocks.en: Additionally, the state-of-the-art comparator MegaMatcher [ 9 ] (COTS) is employed alongside VeriFinger for latent fingerprint feature extraction and template matching, as comparisons in the literature for similar age groups tend to favor latent solutions [ 4 ] , due to their capability of handling degraded impressions. Table V presents the TMR values achieved by frame-fusion at FMR=1.0%, using the top ranked quality method of Table IV . Upward arrows denote the relative gain over VeriFinger alone, using the corresponding results reported in Table III as reference.
blocks.zh: 此外,最先进的参照系统 MegaMatcher[9](COTS)与VeriFinger一起用于潜在指纹特征提取和模板匹配,因为文献中类似年龄组的比较往往倾向于潜在解决方案[4],因为他们有能力处理已退化的印象。 页:1 V采用表四中排名最高的质量方法,在FMR=1.0%时,通过帧组合得出了德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国的数值。 向上箭头仅指比VeriFinger的相对增益,以表三所报的相应结果为参考.

blocks.en: TABLE V : Matching performance with frame-fusion over VeriFinger and MegaMatcher (Latent) comparators using RPS (tuned) (90 digits per fold, 5 folds).
blocks.zh: 表格五: 在VeriFinger和MegaMatcher(Latent)的参照物上使用RPS(调制)与帧相匹配性能(每折90位,5折).

blocks.en: As shown, frame-fusion improved upon the corresponding single-frame results of Table III in every age group, and latent matching also obtained higher TMR than the Verifinger baseline for all cases. For the 2-month group, fusion and latent matching elevated the top performance from a 90.5 % 90.5\% mean (single-frame, VeriFinger) to 97.6 % 97.6\% , the highest mean value encountered across tables, with a standard deviation of only 0.9 0.9 points. Newborns obtained the largest gains ( 29.7 29.7 points with MegaMatcher; e.g., RPS from 47.5 % 47.5\% to 77.2 % 77.2\% ) from this strategy, but remained the most challenging group as MegaMatcher TMR mean remains at least 16 16 points below the other age groups.
blocks.zh: 如所显示的,框架组合在表三对每个年龄组的相应单一框架结果上都有所改进,潜在匹配还取得了高于所有案例的德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国基准。 对于2个月组,聚变和潜在比对将顶级性能从90.5% 9.5分正值(单方格,VeriFinger)提高到97.6% 97.6分,是各表所见到的最高正值,标准差只有0.9 0.9分. 新生儿从这一战略中获得了最大的收益(MegaMatcher的29.7 29.7分;例如,RPS从47.5% 47.5分到77.2% 77.2分),但仍然是最具挑战性的群体,因为MegaMatcher TMR的平均比其他年龄组低16分。

blocks.en: From 15 days onward, MegaMatcher TMR exceeded 96 % 96\% for all listed methods, which supports video sampling as a viable strategy for capturing high-utility fingerprints from the earliest stages of life, and is compatible with the tuned methods selecting useful frames. Since Table V does not include default or NFIQ2-selected galleries, this experiment does not isolate the contribution of tuning to the fusion gains.
blocks.zh: 从15天起,MegaMatcher TMR在所有上市方法中都超过了96%的96-QQ,它支持视频采样作为从生命最早阶段采集高功用指纹的可行策略,并与选择有用帧的调制方法相兼容. 自兹 页:1 V不包括默认或NFIQ2所选择的画廊,这个实验并不隔离调子对聚变增益的贡献.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, challenges remain in reliably capturing and evaluating fingerprints during the first week after birth, including verification at maternity. Even with thousands of video frames available, 100% TMR may not be achievable at reasonable FMR operating points without a Failure-To-Enroll (FTE) rule. Real-time quality evaluation and feedback to collection agents could therefore help identify cases requiring additional acquisitions. Figure 7 illustrates this limitation using two genuine newborn sample pairs: a successfully matched thumb pair (top) and a false reject involving the little fingers (bottom). The pairs were selected using RPS quality scores and evaluated with frame-fusion and latent matching with a threshold of 70, which yields FMR=1.0% for RPS.
blocks.zh: 然而,在分娩后第一周可靠地采集和评价指纹方面仍然存在挑战,包括产妇核查。 即使有上千个视频帧,在合理的FMR操作点上,如果没有“失败进入”规则,100%的德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国也无法实现。 因此,实时质量评价和向收集机构反馈可有助于查明需要额外采购的案件。 图7用两个真正的新生儿样本对来说明这种限制:一个成功匹配的拇指对(上)和一个涉及小指(下)的假拒绝. 选对采用RPS质量分数,并采用帧组合和潜在比对进行评分,阈值为70,RPS的FMR=1.0%.

blocks.en: Fig. 7 : Examples of genuine newborn sample pairs. The thumb pair (top) exceeded the MegaMatcher threshold, whereas the little-finger pair (bottom) did not.
blocks.zh: 图7:真正的新生儿样本对的例子。 拇指对(上)超过了MegaMatcher的门槛,而小指对(下)则没有.

blocks.en: Although the thumb samples are visually more distinct, involuntary movement, acquisition noise, and the lack of suitable pairings can prevent successful matching, even for relatively clear frames such as the bottom-left image. In such cases, low-quality samples could be excluded using quality-score thresholds that balance TMR gains against exclusion rates, as observed during the FNMR validation in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh: 虽然拇指样本在视觉上更为鲜明,非自愿地移动,获取噪音,以及缺乏合适的配对可以阻止成功配对,甚至对于相对清晰的相框,如从下到左的相片来说也是如此. 在这种情况下,可以采用质量分数阈值排除低质量样本,该阈值将德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国的收益与排除率相平衡,如图4中FNMR验证时所观察到的。

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: The comparison between default and tuned configurations indicates that parameters derived from adult fingerprint norms limit the applicability of otherwise suitable methods to infants. At FMR=1.0%, tuned configurations obtained higher mean TMR than their defaults in every method-age combination. The effect is clearest for the methods with strong fingerprint-specific assumptions, LCS and RPS, whose rank gains over their defaults exceeded the CD at both operating points. Together, these two methods obtained the highest mean TMR at FMR=1.0% in five of six age groups, with margins within the fold standard deviation, however neither differed significantly from the other top-five methods.
blocks.zh: 默认和调制的配置的比较表明,从成人指纹规范中得出的参数限制了其他适当方法对婴儿的适用性. 在FMR=1.0%时,调制组在每种方法-年龄组合中的平均得分高于默认得分。 对于具有强烈指纹特定假设的方法,即LCS和RPS,效果最为明显,因为这两个操作点的分级增益都超过了CD. 这两种方法加在一起,在6个年龄组中的5个组中,在FMR=1.0%时获得最高平均德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国,在折叠标准差之内,但与其他前5个组别方法没有显著区别。

blocks.en: Nevertheless, not all methods benefited equally from tuning. Gabor results were mixed, with consistent gains at FMR=1.0% but not FMR=0.1%. The simpler block-size tuning produced varying gains for RVU and OCL, but neither method was lifted above the adult-oriented standard NFIQ2. Methods which have no tunable inputs, namely SIG and MQCDA, were also shown to be competitive, ranking among the top five at FMR=1.0%, and together obtained the highest TMR mean at FMR=0.1% for three out of the six observed age groups.
blocks.zh: 然而,并非所有方法都从调整中平等受益。 加博尔结果好坏参半,FMR=1.0%但非FMR=0.1%。 更简单的块大小调制为RVU和OCL带来了不同的增益,但这两种方法都没有被解除,高于面向成人的标准NFIQ2. 无可捕性投入的方法,即SIG和MQCDA,也显示具有竞争力,按FMR=1.0%在前五名中排名,在6个观察到的年龄组中,3个年龄组的总得分最高的TMR为0.1%。

blocks.en: In regards to subject age, matching rates was notably lower for newborns, consistent with the well-established difficulty of acquiring high-quality fingerprint images at this age. Performance was also shown to generally improve with age, with only minor variations between the 15-day and 1-month groups and between the 2- and 3-month groups. Within the evaluated subset of UTFPR-IFD, the 2-month group reached the highest TMR mean in frame comparisons, 90.5 % 90.5\% (RPS), which rose to 97.6 97.6 once frame-fusion was combined with a COTS latent comparator (Table V ). Critically, differences across the 15-day to 3-month age groups ( 97.4 97.4 – 97.5 % 97.5\% ) are within the fold standard deviation. Further improvements could be obtained as this fusion rule, which requires two matching frames of the same finger, is less strict than multi-finger acceptance protocols, which could yield further gains.
blocks.zh: 关于受试年龄,新生儿的匹配率明显较低,这与这一年龄获得高质量指纹图像的既定困难是一致的。 成绩也显示随着年龄的增长而普遍提高,15天和1个月组之间以及2个和3个月组之间的差别很小。 在经评价的UTFPR-IFD子集中,2个月组在框架比较中达到最高的德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国平均值,90.5%为90.5%-%(RPS),在框架组合与COTS潜在参照国合并后,增加到97.697.6(表五)。 关键的是,15天至3个月年龄组的差异(97.497.4-97.5 % 97.5)在折叠标准差之内。 由于这个聚变规则需要同指相配的两个相配框,比多指接受协议更不严格,这可能会产生进一步的收益,因此可以得到进一步的改进.

blocks.en: Finally, the Friedman–Nemenyi analysis does not identify a single superior method among the top five, as the differences in their average ranks do not exceed the critical difference. However, these methods rank consistently above most of the remaining methods and configurations, which suggests that they are the most appropriate solutions for infant fingerprints. A combinatorial approach akin to NFIQ2, assimilating complementary ridge properties such as orientation, width and frequency into a unified quality index, therefore appears to be the most promising direction for practical infant fingerprint quality assessment.
blocks.zh: 最后,Friedman–Nemenyi分析没有在前5名中找出一个单一的上等方法,因为他们的平均级别差异没有超过临界差异. 然而,这些方法始终高于大多数剩余的方法和配置,这表明它们是婴儿指纹的最适当解决方案。 与NFIQ2相似的组合方法将取向、宽度和频率等互补的山脊特性同化为统一的质量指数,因此似乎是婴儿指纹质量实际评估最有希望的方向。

blocks.en: In summary, the findings yield several conclusions: • Infant fingerprint patterns differ substantially from adults, such that standard parameters (devised for adults) are ill-suited to capture the characteristic ridge widths, frequencies, and structural properties of infant samples; • Parameterized quality assessment methods can be adapted to infant fingerprints through parameter search, and the resulting configurations establish a baseline for future comparisons; • Matching rates remain relatively low for infants in sample-to-sample comparisons. However, frame fusion and latent comparators substantially improve results. Newborns nevertheless remain the most challenging age group as Table V reports; • A composite index, such as NFIQ2, that integrates complementary features and extends this concept to incorporate age-adaptive components, represents a promising direction for quality-guided infant biometric enrollment.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,调查结果得出了几项结论:婴儿指纹模式与成年人大相径庭,因此标准参数(为成年人而设计)不适合捕捉婴儿样本的特有山脊宽度、频率和结构特性;通过参数搜索,参数化的质量评估方法可以适应婴儿指纹,由此产生的配置为今后的比较确定了基线;在样本与样本比较中,婴儿的匹配率相对较低。 但是,框架组合和潜在参照物大大改进了成果。 然而,新生儿仍然是表五中最具挑战性的年龄组;如NFIQ2等综合指数,综合了互补特征,将这一概念扩大到包括适应年龄的成分,为有质量指导的婴儿生物鉴别入学提供了有希望的方向。

blocks.en: VI Conclusions
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en: This study examined the applicability of available fingerprint quality assessment methods for infants, initially enrolled as newborns and accompanied until 3-month of age. The majority of these methods were designed around adult fingerprint characteristics and are currently part of an international standard [ 7 ] . A parameter search strategy was proposed to reduce the gap between adult and infant fingerprint recognition, using a longitudinal dataset that tracks subjects from birth onward [ 5 ] . The final parameter set produced in this work (separate execution, full database) is available as supplementary material in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 这项研究审查了现有的指纹质量评估方法对婴儿的适用性,这些婴儿最初登记为新生儿,并一直陪伴到3个月大。 这些方法大多是围绕成人指纹特征设计的,目前是国际标准[7]的一部分。 提出了参数搜索战略,以缩小成人和婴儿指纹识别之间的差距,使用一个纵向数据集跟踪从出生开始的受试对象[5]. 在这项工作中产生的最后参数集(单独执行,完整数据库)作为补充材料载于附录A。

blocks.en: By directing the parameter search toward recognition performance, optimal ranges for algorithm features, including ridge and valley width, were identified. These tuned parameters produced measurable improvements in matching rates (TMR@FMR) across all evaluated age groups, demonstrating that parameters derived from adult standards are insufficient when applied to infant fingerprints. Additionally, a stricter recognition protocol could yield further improvements in matching rates, such as requiring the successful match of two or more fingers as recommended by ISO/IEC 2382-37 [ 34 ] . Section IV-C explores a similar frame-fusion solution that is shown to substantially improve TMR values across all ages.
blocks.zh: 通过将参数搜索导向识别性能,确定了算法特征的最佳范围,包括山脊和河谷宽度。 这些调整的参数使所有被评价年龄组的匹配率(TMR@FMR)有了可衡量的改善,表明从成人标准得出的参数在适用于婴儿指纹时是不够的。 此外,更严格的识别协议可进一步提高匹配率,例如要求按照ISO/IEC 2382-37 [34] 的建议成功匹配两个或两个以上的指. 第四-C节探讨一种类似的框架组合解决方案,显示出可以大幅度提高所有年龄的德涅斯特河沿岸摩尔多瓦共和国的数值。

blocks.en: Collectively, these results indicate that existing international standards do not adequately account for the biometric characteristics of infant fingerprints, which differ measurably from those of adults in feature scale and distribution. Nevertheless, the proposed parameter search demonstrates that existing biometric frameworks can be adapted to infant subjects when representative data is available. The optimized parameter sets identified in this work provide a practical foundation for future work aiming to propose solutions to infant fingerprint recognition in maternity settings, where reliable biometric validation helps ensure the identity of newborns to their parents.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果表明,现行国际标准没有充分考虑到婴儿指纹的生物鉴别特征,在特征规模和分布方面,这些特征与成年人的特征有明显不同。 然而,拟议的参数搜索表明,现有生物鉴别框架在有代表性数据时可以适用于婴儿主题。 这项工作确定的优化参数集为今后旨在提出产妇环境中婴儿指纹识别解决方案的工作提供了一个实际基础,在这种环境中,可靠的生物鉴别验证有助于确保新生儿的身份能够传给父母。

blocks.en: Several directions remain open for future research: further investigation into how aging affects ridge and valley widths beyond the observed age groups, potentially up to adulthood; the proposal of international standards that explicitly account for age-dependent pattern characteristics and resolution variability; and the proposal of composite quality indexes for infants. The development of quality estimation, enhancement, feature extraction, and matching methods for high-resolution fingerprints could also yield significant improvements for infant biometrics.
blocks.zh: 未来研究仍有若干方向可循:进一步调查老龄化如何影响观测到的年龄组以外的山脊和河谷宽度,可能直至成年;提出国际标准,明确说明取决于年龄的形态特征和分辨率的可变性;提出婴儿综合质量指数。 高分辨率指纹的质量估计、增强、特征取出和匹配方法的制定,也可大大改进婴儿生物鉴别技术。
